creator: Alexander Terp
description: From tooling feedback, 2026-10-14, 0.16.0 on the devenv. An agent convening a directed council ran `muster msg join --name director`, which was refused because another session that was still running held `director`. Its next command, `muster msg group new <group> --policy <skill>/directed.toml`, succeeded and made it the first member under its pane id. Under `directed.toml` only `director` and `@human` may add, remove, leave or delete, so it could add nobody, and `muster msg leave --group <group>` answered "policy does not let p2bjw90hsf leave it". The group was stranded: only the session holding `director` or the person's own shell could still act on it. `group_new` in `crates/muster-msg/src/service.rs` checks the policy is well formed, but not that its maker holds a role in `membership`. Refusing that case, and naming the roles the policy wants, would have stopped it at the second command. Letting a group's maker always leave or delete it would also work. Card a_2izza44GC is why the join failed.
title: msg group new makes a group its maker cannot run when the policy gives it no membership role
